CREATE TYPE enum_consumer_a AS ENUM ('first','last'); ALTER TYPE enum_consumer_a ADD VALUE 'middle' BEFORE 'last'; CREATE TYPE enum_consumer_b AS ENUM ('other','lastb'); ALTER TYPE enum_consumer_b ADD VALUE 'before' BEFORE 'other'; ALTER TYPE enum_consumer_b ADD VALUE 'after' BEFORE 'lastb'; CREATE TYPE enum_consumer_holder AS (a enum_consumer_a,b enum_consumer_a); CREATE VIEW enum_consumer_source AS SELECT '(middle,last)'::enum_consumer_holder AS v; CREATE TYPE enum_consumer_raw AS (a integer,b integer); CREATE VIEW enum_consumer_invalid AS SELECT '(1,3)'::enum_consumer_raw AS v; CREATE VIEW enum_consumer_even AS SELECT '(2,4)'::enum_consumer_raw AS v

ALTER TYPE enum_consumer_holder ALTER ATTRIBUTE a TYPE enum_consumer_b,ALTER ATTRIBUTE b TYPE enum_consumer_b; ALTER TYPE enum_consumer_raw ALTER ATTRIBUTE a TYPE enum_consumer_b,ALTER ATTRIBUTE b TYPE enum_consumer_b
SELECT (v).a IN ((v).a,(v).b) AS yes,(v).a NOT IN ((v).a,(v).b) AS no FROM enum_consumer_source
SELECT (v).a IN ((v).b,(v).a) AS yes FROM enum_consumer_invalid
SELECT (v).a IN ('before','other') AS no FROM enum_consumer_source
SELECT (v).a=ANY(ARRAY[(v).b,(v).a]) AS yes,(v).a<>ALL(ARRAY[(v).b]) AS different,(v).a<ANY(ARRAY[(v).b]) AS less FROM enum_consumer_source
SELECT (v).a=ANY(ARRAY[(v).b,(v).a]) AS yes,(v).a<>ALL(ARRAY[(v).b]) AS different FROM enum_consumer_invalid
SELECT (v).a=ANY(ARRAY[NULL::enum_consumer_b]) AS unknown,(v).a=ANY(ARRAY[]::enum_consumer_b[]) AS no FROM enum_consumer_invalid
SELECT (v).a BETWEEN (v).a AND (v).b AS yes,(v).a NOT BETWEEN (v).a AND (v).b AS no FROM enum_consumer_source
SELECT (v).a BETWEEN (v).a AND (v).a AS yes FROM enum_consumer_invalid
SELECT (v).a BETWEEN SYMMETRIC (v).b AND (v).a AS yes FROM enum_consumer_source
SELECT (e.v).a BETWEEN (e.v).b AND (i.v).a AS no FROM enum_consumer_even e CROSS JOIN enum_consumer_invalid i
SELECT (v).a IS DISTINCT FROM (v).a AS no,(v).a IS DISTINCT FROM (v).b AS yes,(v).a IS NOT DISTINCT FROM (v).a AS same,(v).a IS DISTINCT FROM NULL AS present FROM enum_consumer_invalid
SELECT CASE (v).a WHEN (v).b THEN 0 WHEN (v).a THEN 1 ELSE 2 END AS choice FROM enum_consumer_invalid
SELECT NULLIF((v).a,(v).a) IS NULL AS yes,NULLIF((v).a,(v).b) IS NULL AS no FROM enum_consumer_invalid
SELECT GREATEST((v).a,(v).b) AS greatest,LEAST((v).a,(v).b) AS least FROM enum_consumer_source
SELECT enum_eq(GREATEST((v).a,(v).b),(v).b) AS greatest,enum_eq(LEAST((v).a,(v).b),(v).a) AS least FROM enum_consumer_even
SELECT enum_eq(GREATEST(NULL,(v).a,NULL),(v).a) AS yes FROM enum_consumer_invalid

CREATE FUNCTION enum_consumer_probe() RETURNS text LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$ BEGIN PERFORM CASE n WHEN 1 THEN (v).a ELSE 'before'::enum_consumer_b END<ANY(ARRAY[CASE n WHEN 1 THEN (v).b ELSE 'other'::enum_consumer_b END]) FROM generate_series(1,2) AS g(n) CROSS JOIN enum_consumer_source; RETURN 'completed'; EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN RETURN SQLSTATE || ': ' || regexp_replace(SQLERRM, '[0-9]+', 'OID', 'g'); END $$; SELECT enum_consumer_probe(); DROP FUNCTION enum_consumer_probe()
